import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
def release_check(model, card, golden_path, X_test, y_test):
    gold = pd.read_csv(golden_path)
    diff = np.abs(model.predict_proba(gold[card['features']])[:,1]-gold['expected']).max()
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_test,model.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1])
    return {'features':list(model.feature_names_in_) == card['features'], 'golden':bool(diff < 1e-9), 'auc':bool(auc >= card['auc_test']-.01)}
